title: [CLM-11] ARCHITECTURE reference and citation errors
description: Review finding CLM-11: ARCHITECTURE reference and citation errors (lens CLM). Location: ARCHITECTURE.md:264; spec/11-transport.md:260. Fix: Keep (a): ARCHITECTURE.md:264 "Open question Q2" becomes "Resolved: §8 Q2". Keep (d): spec/11-transport.md:260 "§5.3 item 4" becomes "§7 item 4" (ARCHITECTURE has no §5.3; §7 item 4 is the channelToken→channelCid/JMAP erratum). Reject (b): the quoted sentence exists verbatim (import/agora-privacy-whitepaper-clean.md:267, "Agora is not anonymous"), and ARCHITECTURE cites it only for the narrow network-layer point, which is still accurate. Reject (c): §2.1 lists IO kinds, and spec 10.4.4 permits mirroring CO-published records to public IPFS (10-relays.md:574), so an IPFS pinning service is a valid IO and nothing contradicts it. Full text: notes/review/CLM-verified.md and notes/review/CLM.md.
